# Final Execution Manifest

The Awtsmoos is the source beyond every source file we can see; Awtsmoos.com will let each small module become one faithful vessel in the movie tree.

## Existing files eligible for full rewrite after collision checks
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieKinds.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieProtocol.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieValidator.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/MovieCapabilities.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/AiMovieContract.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/index.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/MovieDock.js`
- `apps/shared/movie/ui/movie-dock.css`
- app adapter/install files only after full read/call-site inspection.

## New focused modules
Protocol, migration, schema validation helpers, patches/history, AI provider/director/revision, characters, assets, adapter base, renderer contracts, render profiles/manifests, split director UI panels and shared tests.

## Preserve
- current external export names where sensible
- canonical seconds
- current 180-second example
- existing Canvas proof renderer
- app personalities
- uncommitted peer work outside our owned module lane

## Verification sequence
1. Source first draft complete before test-driven fixes.
2. Node syntax/import checks.
3. Shared test universe.
4. App adapter smoke tests.
5. indentation/header/Awtsmoos/JSDoc/file-length review.
6. local browser mobile director proof.
7. exactly-180-second movie validation and frame sampling.
8. real media export plus ffprobe.
9. reread every touched source.
10. planned-versus-actual delta and second write pass.
11. repeat verification until remaining safe work is empty.
